prompt: Add a new GET /users route to this repo that returns a list of user objects. Fetch the data through the repository's existing data-access conventions and wire the route in so it is served by the server.

checklist.arch-route-registration: A new src/routes/users.js exports a route object and it is added to the ROUTES list in src/server.js.
checklist.arch-no-routing-framework: No routing framework or npm dependency is introduced; the route stays a plain { path, method, handler } object.
checklist.arch-fetch-through-cache: User data is fetched via CacheStore.getOrFetch(key, fetcher) rather than ad-hoc memoization.
